title: FEASIBILITY AND PRE-DEVELOPMENT OF INFLATABLE TANKS PROPELLANT STORAGE - EXPRO PLUS
description: To provide a feasibility analysis about the construction, storage, deployment, and operation of propellant tanks that are inflatable.Description:This activity aims at providing a detailed feasibility analysis on the construction, storage, deployment, and operation of propellant tanks that are inflatable. It is envisaged that these propellant tanks can be used to store cryogenic propellant(LOX, LCH4, LH2) or to store conventional propellant (O2, H2, CH4, CO). Most important, inflatable propellant tanks can be used to store the gases produced by using in situ resources in a Regenerative Fuel Cell Systems (RFCS) in electrolysis mode. Applications tothe Moon and Mars will be addressed.Major critical points (material compatibility with propellant, zero boil off for cryogenic propellant,...) are aimed at being investigated and solutions proposed.This activity encompasses the following tasks:- Trade-off analyses of inflatable tank design- Prototype and test a proof of concept (for different applications and propellants for Moon and Mars scenarios)- Roadmap development plan

title: HIGH TEMPERATURE METALIZED PET (POLYESTER) FILM CAPACITORS EXPRO PLUS (RE-ISSUE)
description: To develop metalized Polyester (PET) film capacitors based on Surface Mounting Device (SMD) that can withstand assembly high-temperature stress due to the lead-free transitionDescriptionCurrently, metallized PET film capacitors are mainly used in space for filtering purposes and power electronics. They have low dielectric losses, stable characteristics, and cover power constraints with lower capacitance values than other capacitor families.Unfortunately, owing to the current lead-free transition, there are no capacitors of this family that are able to withstand the high temperatures, around 240 degrees Celsius, induced by the lead-free soldering. These capacitors are not available either in the automotive qualified domain.Capacitors with high capacitance values are only available in through-hole packages and cannot withstand the high temperature stress induced by the lead-free transition. Thus, there is a need to develop an innovative solution of metallized polyester film capacitors, in SMD package in order to ease the integration, and with improved internal design to withstand inherent high-temperature leadfree soldering.This activity encompasses the following tasks: - Literature review and market survey - Technology and process review for the selection of promising solutions - Development and manufacturing of high-temperature metallized PET film capacitors. - Electrical characterization and reliability assessment of the capacitors, including thermal cycling, mechanical testing and assembly verification. - Identification of limitations, improvements and roadmap for future space qualificationProcurement Policy: C(1) = Activity restricted to non-prime contractors (incl.
